description: Two retailers and one web-search surface return the same white sneaker. Exercises cross-source dedupe (same canonical URL from Farfetch and Serper), variant grouping by exact identifier, and the LIKELY_EXACT gate — brand, model and colourway all agree, but no source carrying an identifier also agrees on brand, so EXACT must not be claimed.
notes: The Farfetch listing appears twice — once first-party, once as a Serper shopping card pointing at the same product page. Canonicalization strips `www.` and the tracking parameter, so rule 1 collapses them into a single listing and the first-party row wins. The KicksCrew provider is recorded as a timeout at 3400ms, which is past the 3000ms default per-provider deadline: the case therefore also asserts that a straggler does not remove the two listings that did arrive.
